# Lesson: LEFT JOIN keeps rows that have no match

`customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id` keeps a customer with no orders.
A left outer join returns every row of the left table: `SELECT * FROM customers LEFT OUTER JOIN orders USING (customer_id)`.
